jobs.title: Senior SOC Engineer
jobs.description:
**Introduction**

ANVA has developed a new multi\-tenant SaaS contract management platform for insurers, combining new technology with fifty years of domain expertise. Security is a strategic investment at ANVA as we continue to scale our cloud\-native SaaS platform in a highly regulated industry.

We are looking for a SOC Engineer to build and own ANVA's detection and incident response capability from the ground up. This role focuses on building monitoring capabilities, detections, automation, and response playbooks.

**Your Impact**

As a Senior SOC Engineer, you will define and implement the future of detection engineering and incident response across ANVA. You will own telemetry visibility, build and tune detections, lead incident investigations, develop automation, and serve as the primary technical expert on monitoring and response. Working directly with the IT Security Lead, you will have significant autonomy and influence over the security direction of the company.

You will own the build\-out of our detection engineering and incident response capability, working alongside our managed detection and response (MDR) partner and supporting the technical controls behind our ISAE 3000 assurance program.

Rather than inheriting someone else's security operations model, you will define it yourself. Within two years, you will be able to look at a mature detection and response capability and confidently say: *"I built that."*

**Your Key Responsibilities**

**Detection \& Visibility**

* Own telemetry coverage across cloud, endpoint, identity, application, and infrastructure log sources
* Assess and prioritize the detection and response roadmap against a defined threat model
* Tune MDR\-managed and baseline detections to the insurance and fintech threat landscape
* Develop custom detection logic where coverage gaps exist
* Balance detection effectiveness against alert fatigue and operational noise

**Incident Response \& Automation**

* Design and maintain incident response playbooks covering unauthorized access, data exfiltration, and breach scenarios
* Build triage and evidence collection automation
* Define alert thresholds and escalation criteria used by the MDR partner
* Lead investigations during security incidents
* Run tabletop exercises and continuously improve response procedures

**Compliance \& Governance**

* Own technical controls supporting the ISAE 3000 assurance program
* Support auditors with detection and response\-related inquiries
* Develop and hand over operational runbooks and logging standards to IT, Development, and Operations teams
* Ensure monitoring controls remain aligned with regulatory and customer expectations

**Who Are You?**

You are a Security Engineer with:

* 7\+ years of experience in Security Operations, Incident Response, or Detection Engineering
* Proven experience creating, testing, and tuning detection logic within SIEM or security data platforms
* Experience leading incident investigations from scoping through containment and post\-incident reporting
* Experience working with MDR or outsourced SOC partners
* Strong knowledge of cloud and application telemetry, including AWS environments
* Experience with CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, GuardDuty, IAM, and identity attack paths
* Familiarity with Spring Boot applications and containerized microservices
* Experience working with endpoint telemetry across Windows, Linux, and macOS
* Knowledge of CrowdStrike, AWS Security Lake, Elastic Stack, or equivalent platforms
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and Detection\-as\-Code approaches
* Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar languages
* Strong communication skills and stakeholder management capabilities
* Nice to have: experience with SSDLC and application security tooling such as Aikido, SAST, and SCA platforms

**Additional benefits**

* 13th month
* 8% holiday allowance per year
* 27,5 vacation days per year based on full\-time employment
* A premium\-free pension, meaning ANVA covers the full pension contribution, allowing you to retain more net income
* The option to work from abroad for 4 weeks a year
* A budget of € 750 to set up your home work environment
* Training and development programs at ANVA’s expense
* Company\-organized events, ranging from karaoke and football tournaments to laser tag
* Free coffee, soft drinks, and fruit, plus a partially subsidized lunch by ANVA, with the option to order take away dinner for home.

Soort dienstverband: Fulltime, Parttime, Vaste baan

Salaris: Tot €6\.965,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Bedrijfsfeesten
* Bedrijfsopleiding
* Budget voor professionele ontwikkeling
* Fietsplan
* Gezondheidsprogramma
* Kerstpakket
* Kosteloos parkeren
* Lunchkorting
* Mogelijkheid tot promotie
* Pensioen
* Personeelskorting
* Productkorting werknemers
* Telefoon van de zaak
* Vrijdagmiddagborrel

Screeningsvragen:

* Do you live in The Netherlands?
* Have you built and ran playbooks?
* Do you have experience with Threat Hunting? (Not Threat Modeling)
* Have you improved Security Lakes?

jobs.title: Junior AI Software Engineer (C#)
jobs.description:
Voor een innovatieve organisatie zijn wij op zoek naar een Junior .NET Developer die enthousiast wordt van AI en nieuwe technologie. Deze scale-up heeft een intelligent dataplatform ontwikkeld voor de zachtfruitsector. Met behulp van IoT-sensoren, camera’s en computer-visionmodellen die draaien op Databricks helpen ze telers en verkooporganisaties om betere inzichten te krijgen in hun gewassen, oogstvoorspellingen te verbeteren en voedselverspilling te verminderen.
Het platform is inmiddels live en vormt de basis voor de volgende groeifase. De Azure-omgeving staat, de datamodellen draaien en er ligt volop ruimte om het platform verder uit te bouwen. Dat betekent: nieuwe features bouwen, technologie ontdekken, verbeteren wat er al staat en vooral veel leren.

Je komt terecht in een compact en betrokken team waar ideeën snel worden opgepakt en waar je niet maanden hoeft te wachten voordat je iets daadwerkelijk in productie ziet. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid voor je niveau en volop ruimte om jezelf technisch te ontwikkelen. Samen werken ze aan technologie die niet alleen interessant is, maar ook daadwerkelijk bijdraagt aan duurzamere landbouw en minder voedselverspilling.

Functie

Als Junior .NET Developer ga je vanaf dag één meebouwen aan het platform. Je werkt voornamelijk met C#, .NET Core, API’s en SQL, maar krijgt daarnaast de mogelijkheid om je te ontwikkelen in Azure, data en vooral AI.
AI is binnen deze organisatie geen buzzword voor op de roadmap. Ze zijn actief aan het ontdekken hoe AI Agents en Agentic AI kunnen worden ingezet om softwareontwikkeling slimmer, sneller en innovatiever te maken. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan AI die developers ondersteunt bij het schrijven, testen en verbeteren van code, maar ook aan nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen het platform zelf.
Je hoeft absoluut nog geen AI-expert te zijn. Nieuwsgierigheid is belangrijker dan ervaring. Vind je het interessant om met ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude of andere AI-developmenttools te experimenteren? Heb je tijdens je studie, stage of in een eigen project al eens met AI of LLM’s gewerkt? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen.
Je werkt samen met ervaren developers en de CTO. Hierdoor leer je niet alleen hoe je goede code schrijft, maar ook hoe je nadenkt over architectuur, schaalbaarheid, cloud en data. Je krijgt de vrijheid om nieuwe technieken uit te proberen en wordt aangemoedigd om met ideeën te komen.
Omdat het team relatief compact is, zie je bovendien direct wat er met jouw werk gebeurt. Geen eindeloze lagen tussen idee en uitvoering, maar bouwen, testen, leren en verbeteren.

Eisen

Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar
Basiservaring met C# en/of .NET vanuit studie, stage, werk of eigen projecten
Basiskennis van SQL
Interesse in Azure en cloudtechnologie
Je wordt enthousiast van AI en nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen
Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI Agents / Agentic AI en moderne AI-development tooling
Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe technologie zelf uit te proberen
Je bent leergierig, zelfstandig en niet bang om vragen te stellen
Je neemt graag initiatief en denkt mee over hoe dingen slimmer kunnen
Je voelt je prettig in een startup / scale-up omgeving

Pré:

Ervaring met Azure
Ervaring met API development
Ervaring met Databricks of data-intensieve systemen
Je hebt al eens gewerkt met LLM’s, AI Agents, GitHub Copilot of andere AI-developmenttools
Je bent gevestigd in de regio Eindhoven vanwege samenwerking en afstemming op locatie
Engels is belangrijk in deze rol; Nederlands is een plus, maar geen harde eis

Aanbod

Een salaris tot ca. €3.800,- bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van ervaring
40 uur per week
25 vakantiedagen
8% vakantiegeld
Pensioenregeling

Activiteiten buiten werktijd zoals bbq’s, sportdag, rooftop concert, lunchen, feestjes en meer!

De mogelijkheid om actief mee te bouwen aan de AI-developmentvisie van de organisatie

Within approximately three months, you will be expected to deliver a clear target architecture, reusable integration patterns, an implementation roadmap and a recommendation for an initial pilot.

Assess the current application, workflow and system architecture.
Design a target architecture for integrating AI services into existing enterprise applications.
Define API-based and event-driven integration patterns.
Design orchestration, authentication, data flows and system dependencies.
Integrate AI and LLM-based services hosted through Databricks.
Help transform standalone AI capabilities into reusable enterprise services.
Define clear service boundaries, interfaces and integration standards.
Translate business journeys and use cases into implementable technical designs.
Identify technical dependencies, constraints, risks and implementation priorities.
Address enterprise requirements around security, privacy, IAM, auditability, resilience, scalability and monitoring.
Produce architecture diagrams, integration blueprints and technical documentation.
Create a pragmatic implementation roadmap and recommend the first AI integration pilot.
Work closely with business, AI development, data, architecture, security and application teams.

Required Experience
Strong experience as a Solution Architect, AI Architect, Integration Architect or AI Consultant
.
Proven experience designing integration blueprints for embedding AI services into existing enterprise workflows.
Strong knowledge of enterprise and legacy application integration.
Hands-on experience with Databricks
.
Practical experience integrating LLMs / Generative AI services
, ideally Azure OpenAI or OpenAI models, into production environments.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, API integration, event-driven architecture and orchestration
.
Experience with authentication, access management and secure enterprise integrations.
Ability to define both current-state and target-state architectures.
Experience operationalising AI or data services in enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of security, privacy, monitoring, resilience, auditability and scalability.
Experience working across multiple technical and business stakeholder groups.
Able to work independently and deliver tangible outcomes within a short consulting engagement.

Highly Desirable
Previous experience within banking, financial services, lending, credit underwriting or vendor finance
.
Experience integrating AI into workflow, case-management or decisioning platforms.
Azure cloud experience.
Dutch language skills.

Important Requirements
Candidates must:
Be available for 38–40 hours per week
.
Live within approximately 1.5 hours travel time of Eindhoven
.
Be comfortable working full-time from the Eindhoven office during the onboarding period
.
Speak fluent English.

Drive innovation through POCs, technical evaluations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Communicate progress proactively, highlighting risks and removing delivery impediments.

Essential

Hands-on experience building and supporting enterprise level latency‑sensitive system

Background in designing and maintaining distributed, event‑driven, cloud‑native applications.
Strong understanding of Computer Science fundamentals
SDLC experience across design, development, QA, deployment, and production support.
Ability to balance rapid delivery with architectural rigour and long‑term maintainability.
Relational database design and optimisation skills (MSSQL, MySQL).

Desired

Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerisation (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS).

jobs.description:
Azure Integration Developer -
Azure Developer, Azure Integration Services, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, Azure Functions, Function Apps, Logic Apps, Logic App Workflows, Azure API Management, APIM, Asynchronous Messaging, Queues, Topics, Pub/Sub, REST APIs, API Security, Authentication, Authorisation, Managed Identities, Key Vault, OAuth, C#, .NET, Microservices, BizTalk, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, T-SQL, Bicep, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps, XML, JSON, Azure Networking, VNets, Private Endpoints – Nottingham - £55,000, £60,000

We are looking for an Azure Integration Developer to develop and support cloud integration solutions using Azure Integration Services. This is a hands on individual contributor position focused on building, maintaining and supporting integrations used across a major global technology programme.

The successful candidate will have genuine practical experience developing integrations using Azure Service Bus and Azure event services, alongside strong experience with either Azure Functions or Azure Logic Apps workflows. Candidates do not need to be equally experienced in both Functions and Logic Apps.

The role will work within an agile development team, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical designs and supporting applications throughout their lifecycle.

There will also be some support for legacy applications using older .NET, SQL and BizTalk technologies, although these are not the primary focus.

Key Skills & Experience:

At least five years of total commercial technology experience
Genuine hands on experience developing and supporting integrations using Azure Integration Services
Strong practical experience with Azure Service Bus, including queues, topics, subscriptions, retries and dead letter handling
Experience using Event Grid and Event Hubs within event driven integration solutions
Strong development experience with either Azure Functions or Azure Logic Apps workflows
Ability to explain the purpose of different Azure integration components and select appropriate services for a given requirement
Experience developing and supporting secure API and messaging based integrations
Understanding of integration security, including authentication, authorisation, managed identities, Key Vault, OAuth and secure API access
Understanding of cloud integration design patterns and the ability to implement agreed technical solutions
Experience producing clear technical designs, specifications and supporting documentation
Ability to translate business requirements into clear and concise technical specifications
Experience supporting production integrations, investigating issues and maintaining stable services
Strong analytical, problem solving and communication skills
Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks, prioritise effectively and meet deadlines

Desirable Experience:

C# and .NET development
Azure API Management
RESTful and SOAP web services
Microservices and object oriented programming
Bicep, Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools
Source control, CI/CD and work management tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub or Jira
BizTalk integration development
Microsoft SQL Server or Azure SQL, including T-SQL, stored procedures, functions and database design
SSIS, SSRS or Azure Data Factory
XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON
Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, private endpoints, private DNS, NSGs and secure cloud connectivity patterns

Responsibilities:

Develop high quality Azure integration solutions that meet agreed project requirements and development standards
Build and support integrations using Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, Azure Functions or Logic Apps workflows
Implement functionality according to agreed technical designs and timescales
Ensure developed solutions are maintainable, secure and suitable for future development

Experience designing systems and solutions independently

Experience working across multiple technology stacks

jobs.title: Software Standards Manager
jobs.description:
Alliance Automotive Group (AAG) is a leading distributor of passenger and commercial vehicle parts to the independent automotive aftermarket in Europe. It operates in France, the U.K., Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Hungary and Romania. The company is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Genuine Parts Company (GPC), the largest global automotive replacement parts distributor with activities in North America, Europe, and Australasia. AAG’s network serves thousands of customers across Europe supported by a logistics infrastructure of 75 Distribution Centres, approximately 2,550 Stores and thousands of vehicle repairers, body shops and auto-centres. AAG has a revenue of 3.4 billion euros with over 17,000 employees. Learn more at www.allianceautomotivegroup.eu

The Software Standards Manager is a new role within Alliance Automotive UK & Ireland, reporting to the Head of Digital & Internal Applications. Operating across both B2B, B2C and internal technology teams, this role exists to bring structure, visibility, and control to a diverse and evolving software landscape shaped by organic and acquisition growth.

With multiple homegrown and proprietary applications primarily built on .NET and LAMP stacks, our engineering teams have historically operated with autonomy in tooling, frameworks, and processes. As we continue to scale, we must now centralise standards around source code management, vulnerability remediation, technical debt allocation, and risk reporting—without disrupting the pace of business value delivery.

The Software Standards Manager acts as the bridge between delivery-focused development teams and compliance, cyber, and risk stakeholders. This role protects engineering capacity by creating a structured intake and prioritisation model for security and compliance requests, ensuring they are logged, translated into backlog items, and progressed in a measurable way.

You will own the catalogue of internally developed applications, maintain visibility of framework lifecycle status, and oversee vulnerability posture across SAST and monitoring tools such as New Relic and Tenable. Through clear weekly reporting and monthly scorecards, you will provide leadership with a single, reliable view of remediation progress and risk exposure.

This is a highly visible and influential role, combining governance, technical literacy and stakeholder management to ensure our software estate is secure and sustainable.

Responsibilities

Technical Role Delivery

Own and maintain a centralised catalogue of all internally developed applications, including framework versions, hosting environments, ownership, and lifecycle status
Drive the centralisation and standardisation of code repository management and software governance practices
Establish and manage a structured intake process for cyber and compliance requirements
Consolidate vulnerability findings from tools such as New Relic, Tenable, and other monitoring platforms
Translate security and compliance findings into clearly defined, prioritised backlog items within Agile workflows
Participate in Agile ceremonies (stands-ups, reviews, retrospectives) to ensure visibility and progress of remediation tasks
Advocate for and track a defined allocation of development capacity toward technical debt and vulnerability remediation
Protect development teams from unstructured or reactive requests by creating a controlled and prioritised engagement model

Performance & Reporting

Act as the primary liaison between Digital, Compliance, and Cyber teams
Design and own structured reporting templates, dashboards, and scorecards
Provide weekly progress updates and monthly governance scorecards to the Head of Department(s) and wider stakeholders
Establish a single source of truth for software risk posture and remediation progress
Clearly communicate risk exposure, remediation velocity, and technical debt reduction trends
Reduce reactive reporting cycles by implementing consistent and predictable governance communications
Support leadership decision-making with accurate, transparent, and actionable insights
Deliver a long-term change program to enable Ping Identity IGA & MFA across all employee-accessed applications

Essential Requirements

Candidate Qualities & Experience

Proven experience working within software engineering environments (Agile/DevOps)
Strong understanding of SDLC, backlog management, and sprint planning processes
Practical experience with vulnerability management and SAST tooling
Ability to interpret technical risk and translate it into prioritised, actionable remediation plans
Demonstrated ability to influence engineering teams without direct line management authority
Experience designing and delivering structured reporting to senior stakeholders.
Working knowledge of modern application stacks (including .NET and/or LAMP environments)
Familiarity with cloud hosting environments and application lifecycle management
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or related discipline

Highly Desirable Qualities

Experience centralising code repositories and driving engineering standards across multiple teams
Exposure to multi-entity or acquisition-led environments with fragmented technology estates
Experience engaging with Cyber Security and Compliance stakeholders
Experience building governance dashboards or automated reporting metrics
Exposure to SSO and IGA rollout projects (preferably Ping Identity)
Relevant professional certifications, such as:
Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
Agile/Scrum certifications
ITIL (Service Management)

Personal Attributes

Structured and disciplined thinker who brings order to complex environments
Pragmatic and commercially aware, balancing risk reduction with business value delivery
Calm and credible under pressure, able to manage competing stakeholder demand
Confident communicator who can translate technical detail into executive-level clarity
Resilient and assertive when protecting engineering capacity
Naturally collaborative, building trust across Development, Cyber, Compliance, and Leadership teams
Outcome-focused, with a bias toward measurable progress and continuous improvement

Not the right fit? Create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Fixed Term)
jobs.description:
About The Role

The University of Cambridge's Information Services is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer. You will join a multidisciplinary development team within a Division of 50 engineers building high-profile bespoke web systems and cloud-native services, and modernising existing applications.

This is a hybrid position, with amazing benefits, like a defined benefit pension and 41 days of annual leave inclusive of public holidays.

Our services are public-facing and support University staff and students (~60,000 people), meaning your work will have a significant impact on the reputation of one of the world's leading universities. We develop new services using modern web architectural standards with an emphasis on reusability, APIs, test automation, and CI. Services are deployed to cloud infrastructure in Docker containers.

Our technology stack is published in our Guidebook and comprises technologies like Google Cloud, Terraform, Docker, Python, Django, React, and TypeScript. We maintain a DevOps culture and use Scrum for our day-to-day work. We have also adopted an "open by default" approach to new work and thus you can find much of our work to date in our GitLab. The team also produces a Guidebook that collects the team's practices and useful information at https://guidebook.devops.uis.cam.ac.uk/

What we're looking for

You will be highly skilled in modern software development, testing, security, and operations, and be an expert in:

Architecting secure-by-design web applications and APIs with a focus on maintainability and stability, using clean code.

Integrating applications via APIs, event buses, and asynchronous tasks.

Writing expert-level Python and Django, with working knowledge of TypeScript and React (or comparable languages and frameworks).

Packaging web applications in Docker containers.

Writing and applying efficient tests with good knowledge of testing frameworks and testing best practices.

Conducting thorough code reviews.

Using AI coding assistants effectively, writing clear prompts, critically reviewing AI-generated code, and taking responsibility for its correctness, security, and maintainability.

Building CI/CD pipelines in GitLab to test and deploy web applications to the cloud using Terraform.

Working with Google Cloud or similar cloud platforms.

Managing software requirements, priorities, and dependencies.

Driving improvements in technical architecture, standards, and processes, and choosing the right solution for the problem (switching off, extending, building, or buying).

Debug effectively in unfamiliar applications.

Ways Of Working

Work in cross-functional teams using a DevOps approach, mentoring more junior engineers.

Communicate clearly in both written and verbal forms, and collaborate with University colleagues, users, and business representatives to gather and refine detailed requirements.

Focus on delivery while taking a continuous-improvement approach to existing services.

Learn new skills proactively and stay current with modern practices.

Apply AI tools pragmatically as they evolve, without compromising the quality, security, or ownership of the code you ship.

Work across products and teams to build consistent architectures, thinking through their impact on other services and the wider organisation.

Understand specifications and produce simple architectures from complex problems.

Drive work to completion, adjusting pace to the urgency of the task.

Fixed-term: The funds for this post are available for 2 years in the first instance.

Applications are welcome from internal candidates who would like to apply for the role on the basis of a secondment from their current role in the University.

We welcome applications from individuals who wish to be considered for part-time working or other flexible working arrangements.

We particularly welcome applications from women and /or candidates from a BME background for this vacancy as they are currently under-represented at this level in our department.

Click the 'Apply' button below to register an account with our recruitment system (if you have not already) and apply online.

If you would like more information about this role, informal enquiries can be directed by email to Abraham Martin, Head of DevOps amc203@cam.ac.uk

Please quote reference VC50478 on your application and in any correspondence about this vacancy.

The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society.

The University has a responsibility to ensure that all employees are eligible to live and work in the UK.
